{{Top|leg}}
'''Air exchange filters''' were part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system. [[Ahric Korownosek]] augmented the air exchange filters aboard the ''[[Command Performance]]'' to accommodate more passengers than a standard [[Starlight-class light freighter|''Starlight''-class light freighter]] could carry.<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
